name: kotgent
description: Kotgent task and structured-plan workflows with browser review, coordinated worker sessions and verified serial merges

interface.shortDescription: Kotgent tasks, plans and execution workflows
interface.longDescription: Create and execute repository tasks and structured plans through the kotgent CLI and git, with browser review, pane-resolved identity and coordinated worker sessions.
defaultPrompt: $kotgent:create-tasks create focused backlog tasks from this implementation plan
$kotgent:make-plan create a structured plan for this task and wait for my review
$kotgent:exec-plan execute this approved plan through final human review
$kotgent:sync-tasks compare the active backlog with this repository
$kotgent:take-task take the next eligible task and work it through review
